objective: Descubrir exclusivamente las columnas reales necesarias para la conciliacion ISCAM post parche. Sin DML/DDL, sin Produccion.

queries.name: iscam_target_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2','Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos','Finanzas_CortesCaja') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: unidades_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name='Unidades_Negocio' ORDER BY c.column_id
